projectDescription: A self-hostable PaaS platform that automatically detects, builds, and deploys Next.js, Vite, and Node.js applications from GitHub repositories using Docker containers and Cloudflare R2 storage.
keyFeatures: Automatic framework detection (Next.js, Vite, Node.js) with zero configuration
GitHub OAuth integration with automatic webhook registration for CI/CD
Docker-based container isolation for every deployment
Hybrid deployment engine: static assets to Cloudflare R2, dynamic apps as containers
Real-time deployment logs streamed via Redis pub/sub
Custom domain support with CNAME-based DNS verification
BullMQ job queue system with worker/builder/dispatcher microservices
Multi-channel notifications (Email via Resend, Slack, Discord, WhatsApp via Twilio)
Caddy reverse proxy with automatic TLS/SSL termination
publicApiSurface: GET /api/v1/projects — List all projects for authenticated user
POST /api/v1/projects/import — Import a GitHub repository as a new project
GET /api/v1/projects/:id — Get a single project with deployments
PATCH /api/v1/projects/:id — Update project name, build config, custom domain
POST /api/v1/projects/:id/deploy — Manually trigger a new deployment
POST /api/v1/projects/:id/envs — Add or update an environment variable
GET /api/v1/deployments — List recent deployments across all projects
GET /api/v1/repository — List GitHub repositories for the authenticated user
POST /webhook/:projectId — GitHub webhook endpoint for push events
